- Ventricular septal defect (VSD)  
- Pulmonary stenosis (PS)  
- Overriding aorta  
- Right ventricular hypertrophy (RVH)

Urgent pediatric cardiology referral is indicated for risk stratification, assessment of pulmonary artery anatomy, and planning for definitive surgical correction (typically complete repair in infancy or early childhood, depending on severity and stability).
